text:
eli.k: kicking off staged rollout v2025.06 -> prod. plan: canary 3% -> 12% -> 30% -> 100%. change window ends 06:00 UTC. release notes https://redwood.example/release/v2025.06 :rocket:
deploy-bot: Staged rollout started (id: r-20250602-11). advancing to 12% in ~8m unless flagged.
mina.s: seeing token-cost anomaly on eu hosts once canary hit ~8% at 3112223360. cost/unit for long summarization requests spiked ~2.1x. graphs: https://grafana/redwood/d/token-costs
tom.h: any latency or errors with that?
mina.s: latency p95 stable, no 5xxs. looks like a path with heavy prompt length and different model tracing down a more expensive execution kernel.
eli.k: propose quick vote: :thumbsup continue global rollout, :thumbsdown rollback to v2025.05, :hand pin eu-west to v2025.05 and continue elsewhere. 5m to vote.
tom.h: :hand pin eu-west. there's a concurrent analytics sweep in EU that could amplify costs.
slo-bot: Noted alert window. If token-cost >1.8x baseline OR errors >0.3% mark for rollback.
deploy-bot: Reached 12% at 3112223380. Autosafety holding per gate.
mina.s: running targeted trace to map which codepath flips to expensive kernel. will post snippet.
eli.k: tally so far 1 hand (tom.h). leaning to regional pin for eu-west and continue. need one more quick ack.
tom.h: executing pin now. command:
```
redwoodctl rollout pin --region eu-west --service summarizer --from v2025.06 --to v2025.05 --reason "token-cost spike + concurrent analytics sweep"
```
deploy-bot: Pin job queued j-112233. ETA ~25s.
ops-bot: eu-west pin completed at 3112223420. traffic for eu-west reverted to v2025.05.
eli.k: pausing global rollout at 12% pending 30m observation. ops: keep an eye on token-cost, p95, and error-rate. rollback criteria: token-cost >1.8x for 10m OR errors >0.5% sustained 5m.
mina.s: posted trace: one request path falls back to a precision-fallback kernel under certain sequence lengths, that's the cost jump. I'll open a follow-up PR for a targeted kernel tweak and add a feature-flagged fallback.
tom.h: i'll monitor billing stream and infra burdens.
slo-bot: SLA oncall paged @slo-oncall for visibility.
eli.k: tagging release with "partial-pin-eu-west" and updating release notes. no full rollback for now; if token-cost normalizes, we'll resume ramping after the hold. keeping thread for decision log. :memo:
